title: An arrow leads from hard-working to ballerina.

illustrates.quote: An arrow leads from hard-working to ballerina.

resolution: Both runs already agreed byte-for-byte on this file (wording, textLines, and illustrates.rule) — confirmed directly against the source at the given textLines. Unlike the §19 gold precedent (where both runs shared a single hard-set placeholder rule id on all six embedded quotes), both runs here already correctly set illustrates.rule to this quote's own citing rule (18.8.2e), matching the source exactly; no placeholder-id bug recurs in §18.
